name: t2v_benchmark
description: A benchmark for text-to-video (T2V) tasks that assesses alignment between textual descriptions and video content, typically used for retrieval and generation evaluation. It supports evaluation of models' ability to retrieve relevant videos given text queries and to generate videos coherent with text prompts.
evaluation_method: retrieval metrics (Recall@K, mAP) and generation quality metrics (FID/CLIPScore)
general_score_metric: Recall@1 (for retrieval) / FID or CLIPScore (for generation)
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face benchmark with limited but growing adoption among text–video model developers.
